Here's what I added to `.github/workflows/e2e.yml`:

**`notify-slack` job** that:
- Runs after all matrix agents complete (`needs: [e2e-tests]`)
- Only fires when at least one agent failed (`if: always() && needs.e2e-tests.result == 'failure'`)
- Sends a single Slack message via `slackapi/slack-github-action@v2.1.0` with:
  - Failure indicator and branch name
  - Link to the workflow run (so you can see which specific agents failed)
  - Commit SHA and actor for context

**Required secret:** `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` — make sure this is set in your repo's GitHub Actions secrets with your Slack incoming webhook URL.
